t: This is the Fleet Air Arm Memorial, sometimes known as Daedalus. It commemorates the Royal Naval Air Service and the Fleet Air Arm, from their beginnings in 1914 and 1924, through both world wars, Korea, the Falklands and the Gulf War. More than six thousand people were killed across those conflicts. The sculptor was James Butler, a British artist best known for his 1980 statue of Richard III in Leicester.
